# #1 PRD Prompt (Product Requirement Document)
### Generated by Taha Jaffri

Use this template to generate a full, robust PRD before building any app or website in Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, or any other text-to-code tool. Fill every section completely. Vague input leads to vague output!

---

## 📋 THE PRD TEMPLATE

### PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Project name:** [what are you calling this]
- **One line description:** [what does this do and for who]
- **Primary goal:** [what is the single most important thing this website must achieve]

### TARGET USER
- **Who is the main user:** [be specific, not "everyone"]
- **What problem are they coming to solve:** [one sentence]
- **What does success look like for them:** [what happens after they use your site]

### PAGES AND STRUCTURE
List every page needed:
- **Page name:** [e.g. Landing Page]
  - **Purpose:** [what must this page do]
  - **Key elements:** [list the must-have sections]

- **Page name:** [e.g. Dashboard]
  - **Purpose:** [what must this page do]
  - **Key elements:** [list the must-have sections]

*(Add as many pages as needed)*

### FEATURES — MUST HAVE
List only what the site cannot launch without:
1. **[Feature name]** — [one line on what it does]
2. **[Feature name]** — [one line on what it does]
3. **[Feature name]** — [one line on what it does]

### FEATURES — NICE TO HAVE
List what would improve it but is not critical:
1. **[Feature name]**
2. **[Feature name]**

### DESIGN REQUIREMENTS
- **Overall feel:** [e.g. minimal, bold, corporate, playful]
- **Color preference:** [specific colors or "AI can decide"]
- **Font style:** [e.g. modern sans-serif, classic serif]
- **Reference sites I like:** [paste 1-3 URLs]
- **What to avoid:** [anything you definitely do not want]

### TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- **Authentication needed:** [yes/no — login/signup]
- **Database needed:** [yes/no — if yes, what data is stored]
- **Payments needed:** [yes/no]
- **Mobile responsive:** [yes — always say yes]
- **Any integrations:** [e.g. Stripe, Google Analytics, email service]

### CONTENT
- **Copywriting:** [AI generate / provide own copy]
- **Images:** [real images / AI generated / placeholders]
- **Logo:** [provided / needs to be created / text only]

### SUCCESS CRITERIA
How will you know this website is done well:
1. [e.g. A first time visitor understands what the site does in under 5 seconds]
2. [e.g. The checkout flow works without errors]
3. [e.g. It loads fast on mobile]

---

## 💡 HOW TO USE THIS:
1. Fill every section above completely.
2. Copy the filled template.
3. Paste the entire document as your first prompt/message in **Lovable**, **Bolt.new**, or **Cursor**.
4. **Do not start building before sending this!** This single step will save you hours of back-and-forth and wasted credits.
